structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Present the ride’s imposing scale and ancient-temple staging from an observer’s viewpoint while preserving its sense of extreme tension.
structured_intent.initial_state: A rider-filled horizontal gondola is suspended beside a carved temple relief, with the articulated arms and supports occupying the foreground.
structured_intent.primary_action: Move through the visible depth of the scene toward the gondola and temple relief.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The gondola and carved relief remain fully visible in a measurably closer or shifted composition with clear parallax between foreground supports and the temple wall.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: The gondola, seats, restraints, long arms, pivots, and supports retain their rigid shapes and existing attachments.
structured_intent.identity_invariant: The same single ride assembly, gondola, and exact set of visible riders remain present and recognizable.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The riders remain visibly secured in a tense thrill-ride moment, and the attraction retains its monumental temple presentation.
structured_intent.feasibility_assessment: The articulated ride, seated riders, restraints, pivots, and multiple depth planes are visible, but the ride’s travel direction and current mechanical phase are ambiguous; subject animation would require invented motion, while a source-grounded camera move is feasible.

scene_plan: Use a continuous five-second rightward lateral track with the gondola and golden relief as the focal target. Maintain a calm uniform pace through most of the shot and soften only at the end; cap foreground displacement at 8% of frame width and reveal no space beyond the photographed environment.

prompt.positive: The camera tracks gently to the right toward the rider gondola and temple relief, with rigid source-grounded parallax while the complete ride assembly, restraints, and all visible riders remain unchanged. At the end, the near red support has moved roughly 6–8% across the frame, revealing only slightly more of the already visible relief and masonry.
